data: Žak, mlad fant, se po smrti svojih staršev odpravi na jadrnico v iskanju miru in spominov, a pot mu prekriža Lučka, pretirano zgovorna punca, ki se mu prilepi za hrbet in mu sledi vse do jadrnice v marini. Prepriča ga, da jo vzame s sabo na krov in na jadranju po Jadranu se izkaže, da sta drug drugemu najboljše zdravilo za usode, ki jih prestajata. (A young man struggling with the death of his parents meets an extroverted girl who joins him on his sailing trip. While spending time together, the dark secrets they are both running away from start to show.)
